title: Geometry of Straight Lines: Angles on a Line, at a Point and Vertically Opposite Angles
seo_title: Grade 7 Geometry of Straight Lines Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and describe pairs of lines: parallel, perpendicular and intersecting lines; recognise and describe angles on a straight line, angles around a point and vertically opposite angles; classify and measure angles.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 geometry worksheets: kinds of angles, angles on a straight line, around a point and vertically opposite angles. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Angles on a straight line add up to 180°.
  • Angles around a point add up to 360°.
  • When two lines cross, the vertically opposite angles are equal.
  • Perpendicular lines meet at 90°. Parallel lines never meet.

Examples

Example

Two angles on a line: 115° and x

180 − 115

Answer: x = 65°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
360° on a lineA straight line is 180°.
Vertically opposite add to 180°They are equal.
The wrong scaleStart from 0° on one arm.

items.q: Classify the marked angle.
items.e: An acute angle is smaller than a right angle: less than 90°. This angle is 35°.
An obtuse angle is bigger than a right angle but smaller than a straight angle: between 90° and 180°. This angle is 125°.

items.q: Classify the marked angle.
items.e: A right angle is exactly 90°, a quarter turn. The small square shows it. Turning the angle does not change its size or its name.
An obtuse angle is bigger than a right angle but smaller than a straight angle: between 90° and 180°. This angle is 160°.

A reflex angle is bigger than a straight angle but smaller than a full turn: between 180° and 360°. Look at the arc: it goes around the outside. This angle is 230°. (The gap between the arms is 130°, but the arc marks the big angle around the outside.)

items.q: What type of angle is 35°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 35° is acute.

items.q: What type of angle is 90°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 90° is right angle.

items.q: What type of angle is 128°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 128° is obtuse.

items.q: What type of angle is 215°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 215° is reflex.

items.q: What type of angle is 179°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 179° is obtuse.

items.q: What type of angle is 300°?
items.e: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: between 90° and 180°. Reflex: between 180° and 360°. So 300° is reflex.
